description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
